g.text: The shapes of requests and results
Kept for the old desktop app

g.title: Website works through Website back end.
Website back end asks for numbers from Request handling.
Pick generation picks and scores tickets with Strategies library.
Draw history lookup fetches draw history from Draw history service.
Legacy desktop support reads draw history from Draw history service.
Draw history service reads Saved draws.
Results updater has each game refreshed by Results reader.
Results reader downloads results from Texas Lottery website.
Results reader saves draws into Saved draws.
Results updater announces each finished refresh to Draw history service.
